verdict.rationale: Adyen's tipping docs list several tipping methods, including tipping from the POS app, from the terminal and on the receipt. With POS-app tipping, the shopper accepts, changes or declines the suggested tip on the payment terminal, so on-reader tip collection with custom amounts is documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence of configurable percentage presets and smart-amount tip options, merchant-ops configuration details (e.g., via Customer Area), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
